title: Qt: Handle dark mode in syntax highlighting.
description:
Add ColorUtils::contrastingTextColor, which chooses an appropriate text
color from the current application palette for a given background.

Use it in SyntaxLineEdit for each state background color. Handle
ApplicationPaletteChange events as well.

commits_data.title: Qt: Handle dark mode in syntax highlighting.
commits_data.message:
Qt: Handle dark mode in syntax highlighting.

Add ColorUtils::contrastingTextColor, which chooses an appropriate text
color from the current application palette for a given background.

Use it in SyntaxLineEdit and FontColorPreferencesFrame for each state
background color.

Fixes #15840.
